description: Per-screen 'time to data ready' spans, each wrapping a LaunchedEffect data load. Spans sit OUTSIDE the existing try/catch so a failed load records FAILURE rather than a silent SUCCESS. product_image_load excludes CANCELED, which Compose produces routinely when a row scrolls out or its key changes. No catalog_serialize span here (unlike iOS): Android fetches the catalog over the network rather than re-serializing it locally, so there is no local CPU step to isolate.
